plan:
I'm on a spot-price electricity contract. Please schedule these appliance cycles for 2024-05-08 so that my electricity cost is as low as possible, without exceeding my household peak load limit:
- dishwasher (dishwasher_1): ready from 06:15, must finish by 15:15
- washing machine (washing_machine_1): ready from 07:30, must finish by 17:00

results.label: Multi-Agent Pipeline
results.message: Great news! Your appliances are scheduled to run efficiently on May 8, 2024. The dishwasher will start at 14:30 and finish by 15:15, while the washing machine will run from 15:00 to 17:00. The estimated cost for this schedule is well within your household limit, ensuring you save on electricity!
